resources.string: Use your desktop browser to chat, upload files, and adjust agent settings in sync with your phone.

Keep Lyra Code in the foreground to keep the screen on. Closing the Activity stops web access. Select shared-storage directories on the phone first. For public access, configure port forwarding or an HTTPS reverse proxy; keep the access code private.
Web access is running. Tap to return to the app.
The web directory browser reads shared storage directly. Grant All files access on this phone to browse and select folders without an SAF picker.
